t: Standing in front of you is the bronze statue of Field Marshal William Slim, about three metres high on a Portland stone pedestal, outside the Ministry of Defence. It's the work of sculptor Ivor Roberts-Jones, made between 1988 and 1993, with lettering by David Kindersley, the stone letter-carver. It's one of three memorials here on Raleigh Green to British leaders of the Second World War, alongside Lord Montgomery and Lord Alanbrooke. Slim, usually known as Bill, was a British military commander, and later served as Governor-General of Australia from 1953 to 1960.
